scope: Read-only independent primary clinical observation, condition/pairing, arithmetic, prior-art, scientific-value and omission challenge. No fresh discovery retrieval or restricted structural-genomics source content inspected. This review does not certify exhaustive public coverage.

actual_validation.independent_primary_read: Parsed four-condition He/Wang clinical panel table, original KIT text and 20-row supplement, cabozantinib clinical/assay text and three supplementary PDFs, sunitinib original abstract, and PGR clinical/RNA text with original Table 1 image. Primary references and exact source bindings follow.
actual_validation.reproduction: Executed frozen analyze_measurements.py with --output into reviewer-owned storage. Its 11 primary-hash/rowspan/count assertions passed; reproduced scientific JSON equals frozen MEASUREMENTS.json after removing the UTC field. This is a reproducibility check, not independent biological replication.

source_portability: Full papers, supplements, source metadata and review render remain ignored cache-only. independent_observation_checks.source: He et al. 2022 (including author Wang), PMC9330136; DOI 10.3389/fgene.2022.791675
independent_observation_checks.all_conditions: One donor, four table conditions: pre-treatment recurrent foot/tibia; axillary node; post-five-cycle doxorubicin/ifosfamide recurrent foot/tibia; femoral metastasis. Eight table rows correctly respect rowspans. Narrative inguinal versus table axillary node label is a retained source inconsistency, not repaired by the reviewer.
independent_observation_checks.observed: EGFR copy values 3.00 then 4.13; descriptive increase 1.13 and 37.666667%. MET 2.80 and MDM4 3.00 occur post chemotherapy; different FBXW7 observations do not establish clone continuity. Source mutation consequence labels are retained without reinterpretation.
independent_observation_checks.limit: No primary-lesion NGS, antiangiogenic exposure, paired RET assay or patient-specific copy-number/purity threshold. A clinical panel copy gain does not establish kinase activation, acquired TKI resistance or observed response to source-listed drugs. Spatial selection, purity and chemotherapy are sufficient alternatives.

independent_observation_checks.source: Urbini et al. KIT 2018, PMC6073125; DOI 10.3390/ijms19061855
independent_observation_checks.all_conditions: All 20 clinical supplement rows checked: five WTS EWSR1::NR4A3 cases, fifteen additional targeted Sanger cases, and three protein blots. One KIT p.D579del case; additional hotspot assays are not whole-gene negative sequencing.
independent_observation_checks.observed: Mutant sample has reported approximately 9.8-fold KIT RNA versus the other four sequenced tumors; protein in all three blots and mild phosphorylation only in the mutant. Published patient responded to sunitinib and was not exposed to imatinib.
independent_observation_checks.limit: A selected 1/20 hotspot observation is not population prevalence or pan-EMC KIT wild-type status. Five RNA cases, three protein cases and twenty clinical cases are different assay denominators. No pretreatment/on-treatment/progression molecular pairs; overlap with the Italian sunitinib cohort remains unresolved. Findings and treatment association are published prior art.

independent_observation_checks.source: O Sullivan Coyne et al. cabozantinib, PMC8776602; DOI 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-21-2480; NCT01755195
independent_observation_checks.all_conditions: All three EMC cohort slots retained. Published case 1010003 has one documented PR after ten cycles and prolonged therapy; individual outcomes and biomarker identities of the other two EMC donors remain unknown. Do not make three responders from one case.
independent_observation_checks.observed: The 42-donor plasma analysis mixes histologies, with baseline, C1D1 3-6-hour post-dose and C2D1 measurements of sMET/HGF/VEGFA/sVEGFR2. Supplement S3 has pooled scatter and response-group boxplots, without histology or donor IDs. No EMC dot or marker trajectory can be authenticated from it.
independent_observation_checks.limit: No EMC assay crosswalk, tumor RET activity or acquired-resistance measurement. The one prior-TKI donor is not individually assigned to EMC. Visit availability and pooled response selection prevent a subtype-specific pharmacodynamic or mediation inference.

independent_observation_checks.all_conditions: Ten progressive advanced EMC cases; primary abstract reports six PR, two SD and two PD, with limited molecular assays. Full individual assay/condition tables are unavailable in the evaluated cloud source.
independent_observation_checks.observed: RET expression/activation is reported, and no secondary resistance was detected at median 8.5 months follow-up (range 2-28).
independent_observation_checks.limit: This observation cannot be repurposed as acquired-resistance biology or universal long-term absence of resistance. No authenticated pre/progression RET pair; absent accessible full text is pending evidence, not biological absence.

independent_observation_checks.source: Wilbur et al. PGR::NR4A3 2022, PMC9489176; DOI 10.1200/PO.22.00039
independent_observation_checks.all_conditions: One 35-year-old female pregnancy-associated cellular EMC case TP_2274; recurrent resection RNA precedes tamoxifen. No independent second donor or post-treatment molecular condition.
independent_observation_checks.observed: Original Table 1 lists outlier RNA NR4A3, PGR and ESR1. Narrative separately lists ESR1/PGR/GREB1; both statements retained. PGR exon 2::NR4A3 exon 2 (5-prime UTR), focal NR4A3 four-copy gain and chromosome 11 three-copy gain are source observations, not evidence of RET adaptation.
independent_observation_checks.limit: The >3000 MI-ONCOSEQ comparison does not release exact case RNA values in a table for a new computation; no digitization or fusion-transcript assignment made. Hormonal mechanism and five-year tamoxifen course are already published. Pregnancy/delivery, repeated resection, tumor mixture and follow-up constrain a causal benefit interpretation.

omission_challenge.condition_integrity: The evaluated four-condition clinical panel, twenty KIT rows with 5/3 assay subsets, three cabozantinib EMC slots, ten sunitinib cases and one PGR donor do not create an eligible acquired-resistance RET pair. Unknown molecular and clinical mappings remain explicit.
omission_challenge.reused_or_pending: Prior authentic RT paired-RNA donors 9 and 29 have no public individual matrix or paired post-RT DNA; RT response definition is local-control/death based. Broader serial sarcoma/TKI/GEO catalogue eligibility, 2014 sunitinib and 2019 pazopanib full tables, pooled biomarker crosswalks and source-identification gaps remain pending. Counts of metadata hits do not certify individual source evaluation.
omission_challenge.restriction: Did not inspect PMC11285543 structural-variant matched-source contents or any interrupted FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA task. Its gap is not a negative result.
omission_challenge.promotion_gate: Suitable accessible public EMC conditions not fully evaluated still block promotion. Shelving is consistent with incomplete coverage; no exhaustive negative statement is endorsed.

scientific_value_and_novelty.strongest_alternative: Published baseline/spatial heterogeneity, chemotherapy selection, donor/lesion mismatch, sample mixture or pooled mixed-histology pharmacodynamics explains the apparent adaptation observations without an acquired RET-resistance mechanism.
scientific_value_and_novelty.new_useful_finding: None in this bounded evaluated packet. Correctly parsing old published tables or drawing a novel assay-unlinked narrative is not a new measurement with practical EMC research value.
scientific_value_and_novelty.decision: ENDORSE SHELVE for the standalone RET adaptation proposal. No material correction to reviewed source arithmetic, case/condition accounting or conservative final decision identified. Validity and added scientific value both fail promotion; no RET absence, antiangiogenic inefficacy or pan-EMC adaptation claim follows.
scientific_value_and_novelty.reopening: Authenticated same-donor, same-lesion or documented matched tumor pre-exposure and acquired-progression samples with measured RET/pathway activity and suitable assay/purity controls; all relevant conditions and prior art evaluated; a concrete biological or therapeutic question beyond the already published cases.

reciprocal_methylation_review.result: Accepts both immutable method/value amendments; all ten EMC, sixty-two controls, seventy-two paired-color IDAT mappings checked. Favorable SARC applicability and age-free stemTOC preserved; no biological array value inspected.
